label: A NECESSARY_2 concretum, from closed grounding collections and contingent grounding (inference)
rule: If no actual root existed, all actual concreta would form a nonempty ground-closed collection without a root; an actual root is not contingent, since every actual contingent concretum is grounded, so with excluded middle it exists at every accessible world
meaning: The AGWF-free form of NecessaryRootFork.necessaryConcreteOfActualGrounded: an inhabited world in which closed grounding collections are rooted and every actual contingent concretum has an actual concrete ground contains a concretum that exists at every world accessible from w. The witness is an actual root. Conditional consequence only.
